title: Continuation doctrine and missing source work
summary: GitHub contains the historical RxSock6 provider dev1 source while project evidence records a qualified dev3 estate. Independent Library and Rasen Falcon searches have confirmed that the exact dev3 / rxsock6 0.1.2 source closure is absent from the currently synchronized estate.
invariants: Do not modify SocketProvider.cls merely to add RxSock6 IPv6 support.
Do not relabel the checked-in dev1 adapter source as dev3.
Do not reconstruct missing dev3 implementation from prose when the exact delivery/source closure is unavailable.
Keep TCP6/UDP6 in RxSock6 and RFC 3678 multicast in the IP Multicast sibling provider.
Keep MLDv2 below the application/provider boundary unless a separate packet-level implementation is intentionally created and qualified.
A qualification/evidence record for dev3 is not a substitute for the exact dev3 source artifact.
procedure: Wait for or recover an authoritative exact RxSock6 provider v0.1-dev3 and rxsock6 0.1.2 source/delivery closure.
Import the exact source with provenance over the historical GitHub dev1 snapshot.
Rerun TCP6 and UDP6 live qualification against Socket Provider dev16 and ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196.
Retain IP Multicast dev2 as the IPv6 RFC 3678 membership authority and rerun its IPv6 multicast qualification only when that sibling package changes.
Update this sphere when the exact source synchronization closes the repository gap.
Use Rasen Falcon lane oorexx_socket_provider_rxsock6 for coordination; lane requests do not substitute for exact artifact provenance or qualification.

provenance.claim: Records canonical documentation drift and the current IPv6 datagram/multicast authority split.

coordination.request_scope: Read-only search for exact v0.1-dev3 / rxsock6 0.1.2 source closure; no reconstruction and no SocketProvider.cls amendment.
